author_preprocessing: Electrical/spectroscopy figure-source CSVs; several supplementary files contain electrostatic/model quantities. The 2026 source paper already analyzes memory behavior.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Group entire sweeps and retention/endurance series by device. Thirty-six FET sweeps do not establish independent fabrication lots. Separate model inputs from observed responses.
